excerpt.zh: 一系列目标已被确定，我们的特工已经悄悄潜入就位。他们一收到我们的信号就会开始进行策反。
excerpt.en: A list of targets has been finalized and our operatives have been quietly drifting their way into position. They await our signal to begin establishing sleeper cells.

texts.zh:
来自行动[This.GetName]的汇报显示，目前为止一切顺利：我们的密探已经成功藏身于[root.target.GetAdj]社会的各个角落，混迹于不起眼的地方，假装自己只是一名普通的百姓。

从现在开始，他们将能够向我们汇报[root.target.GetName]的最新进展，并确保我们具有组织行动的长期能力，如果我们想要组织的话。
texts.en:
Reports from Operation [This.GetName] are favorable so far: our operatives have successfully concealed themselves in a variety of positions across [root.target.GetAdj] society, hiding in plain site and pretending to simply be ordinary citizens. 

From there, they will be able to update us on the latest happenings in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our long-term ability to conduct operations there, should we wish it.
